INPUT.NAME: operaterto
INPUT.SQL: select * from ssoperateri where operateriid in (select distinct operateriid from kupstatusoperateri) order by naziv
INPUT.CAPTION: _operater

INPUT.NAME: KUPStatusId
INPUT.SQL: select s.kupstatusid,s.opis as naziv from kupstatus s inner join kupstatusoperateri o on s.kupstatusid=o.kupstatusid where o.operateriid =@@operaterto order by s.korak
INPUT.CAPTION: _status

INPUT.NAME: DAid
INPUT.SQL: select 0 as Daid,'Nezaprimljeni-0'as Naziv union all select 1 as Daid ,'Zaprimljeni - 1' as Naziv union all select 2 as Daid ,'Arhivirani - 2' as Naziv
INPUT.CAPTION: zaprimljeno

INPUT.NAME: GridOsobe
INPUT.SQL: select oop.operateriid,oop.Naziv, 0 as RedOdobravanja from KUPOdobriOperateri op inner join ssOperateri oop on op.OperateriId=oop.OperateriId where op.KUPOdobriPredlozakId is null order by oop.naziv

INPUT.NAME: operknjizid
INPUT.SQL: select so.OperateriId,ltrim(rtrim(op.Naziv)) as Naziv from KUPStatusOperateri so inner join KUPStatus s on so.KUPStatusId=s.KUPStatusId inner join ssOperateri op on so.OperateriId=op.OperateriId where ltrim(rtrim(s.Opis))='Računovodstvo' order by Naziv
